routes.change: Validate positive safe-integer novel/chapter target; require exact published chapter in published rights-eligible novel; write only for session user.
Validate positive safe-integer novel/chapter target; require exact published chapter in published rights-eligible novel; write only for session user.

dataEntities: Existing bookmarks and history tables only; no migration or new table.
invariants: Novel ID and chapter number must be positive safe integers.
The exact chapter number must belong to the requested novel.
The novel must be published and rights-eligible.
Rejected targets must not mutate existing bookmark or history rows.
The user owner is always taken from authenticated session u.id, never request payload.

integration: Cloudflare source validation on exact integration head
isolation: Worker D1 test must prove cross-account progress isolation before security sign-off.

stagingSteps: Verify valid published chapter targets persist.
Verify missing, draft, rights-ineligible and cross-novel targets are rejected without mutation.
Run cross-account Worker/D1 isolation tests before security sign-off.

status: Proposed; exact-head CI and review required.

integration: Cloudflare source validation on exact integration head
isolation: Cross-account Worker/D1 isolation remains a required follow-up before security sign-off.

migrationPlan.canonicalEntityReuse: Reuse existing bookmarks and history tables; no new data entities.
migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: Existing GET routes and valid POST payloads remain supported; invalid targets are rejected before writes.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Revert Worker handler and policy changes; no data migration or stored-row repair is needed.

privacySecurity.authentication: Both POST routes require an authenticated session.
privacySecurity.authorization: Reader progress mutations are authenticated and scoped to session u.id.
privacySecurity.ownerScoping: The user identifier is never accepted from the request payload.
privacySecurity.csrf: Existing same-origin/session CSRF protections remain applicable.
privacySecurity.rateAndSizeLimits: Existing request body limits and platform rate controls remain unchanged.
privacySecurity.rightsAndPrivacy: Only published rights-eligible novel/chapter targets are accepted; progress remains private to the session owner.

rollback.codeRollback: Revert the reader-progress target validation integration commit; existing stored bookmark/history rows and schema remain unchanged.
rollback.dataRollbackOrForwardRepair: No database migration or production data mutation is introduced.
monitoringSignals: D1 write errors on bookmark/history endpoints

apiContracts: POST /api/bookmark requires a positive safe-integer novel/chapter target, exact published chapter membership and session-derived ownership.
POST /api/history requires a positive safe-integer novel/chapter target, exact published chapter membership and session-derived ownership.

uiLifecycle.clientBootBehavior: Existing reader client continues to call the same API routes.

collisionReview.duplicateRoutes: Existing /api/bookmark and /api/history routes only; no duplicate routes.
collisionReview.duplicateEntities: Existing bookmarks and history tables only.
collisionReview.sharedSurfaceOwners: Reader owns the parser; platform kernel integrates handlers; platform-quality owns tests; platform architecture owns inventories.
